title: When the Inventory Falls
author: August Almeida
blurb: Silas Eastwick, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
